summary: Inside the elevator, Trinity and Neo begin preparing an explosive device. Trinity immediately drops down and cracks open the case, rigging a plastique and napalm charge. Neo then hits the emergency stop, Neo halts the lift, lowers a section of the drop ceiling, and locates the panel leading to the elevator shaft. The scene shows them setting up both a bomb and an escape route out of the elevator.
